concepts.title: Keep evidence with the Spec
concepts.brief: Attach deliberately. Photo not measurement; preserve source and destination.

concepts.title: Ask the next useful question
concepts.brief: Resolve a procurement blocker, not generic shopping. Include duplicate PO lookup where relevant.

concepts.title: Recall the decision and its owner
concepts.brief: Attributed past approval, version and source. Retrieval not new approval.

concepts.title: Keep site context in the conversation
concepts.brief: Short walkthrough location context. No structural/fit certification from imagery.

concepts.title: Check quantity before ordering twice
concepts.brief: Entered dimensions, transparent pack rounding/waste AND check existing PO. Framing based on approved schedule not structural design. Paint coat/coverage assumptions explicit.

concepts.title: Connect sample review to the order
concepts.brief: Request and identify sample, record finish approval, retain sample/batch link; framing use connector/spec reference not decorative sample approval.

concepts.title: Turn a message into a conditional field
concepts.brief: Preserve installer date and prerequisites, source author. No date stripped of condition.

concepts.title: Confirm rather than infer
concepts.brief: Measured site dimension or manufacturer requirement has source; missing counterpart remains unknown. Framing no engineering approval, lighting qualified electrical review.

concepts.title: Expose the schedule risk
concepts.brief: Dated supplier demo ETA and last refresh, compare booked trade. Stale/unconfirmed status stays explicit, not guaranteed live integration.

concepts.title: Compare without hiding the unknown
concepts.brief: Matched attributes plus one unknown. Separate draft supplier question from approving replacement.

concepts.title: Keep trade and budget approvals separate
concepts.brief: Qualified trade confirms fit/spec separately from homeowner budget authority. No implied charge.

concepts.title: Track delivery and receiving ownership
concepts.brief: Demo status timestamp, access notes, assigned receiver and exception. No fabricated service integration. Include partial receipt where relevant.

concepts.title: Share confirmed items and open questions
concepts.brief: Draft pack linked to job/PO and owner, exclude unconfirmed dimensions and flag them. Not sent until explicit review.

concepts.title: Close the order without losing evidence
concepts.brief: Link evidence to job/PO; duplicate check, damaged/partial receipt, return eligibility unknown, no refund claim.

modes.name: Ask and act
modes.interaction: Short question, structured response, explicit reply

modes.name: Photo-led conversation
modes.interaction: Attach site evidence, inspect it, confirm the next action

modes.name: Check the source
modes.interaction: Open the cited evidence sheet, return to the thread

modes.name: Compare in conversation
modes.interaction: Compare two references without leaving the thread

modes.name: Follow through
modes.interaction: A new message updates an existing order or decision record

framingBoundary: User-requested exploratory extension. The market note recommends flooring, not framing.
